etymology_chain.definition: this (masculine singular demonstrative base with analogical -n)

entries.etymology_notes: Inherited from Arabic masculine demonstrative base ذَا (ḏā). While earlier 20th-century philologists (Aquilina 1973: 16) compared final -n to ancient Semitic forms (Biblical Aramaic dēn, Phoenician zn) to refute Barbera's Sicilian borrowing theory, modern comparative Maltese and Arabic linguistics (Borg, Vanhove) refutes any ancient substrate origin. Instead, final -n is analyzed as an internal dialectal Arabic innovation: the plural nasal from dawn (cp. Maghrebi hadun / hadhūna) spread analogically to the singulars (da > dan, di > din), reinforced by the proximal locative hawn ('here'). The bare stem survives in proclitic da, while the Classical/MSA compound with deictic hā- (هٰذَا hāḏā) survives in oratorical hedan via Maltese imāla (hā- > he-).

definitions.text_en: this; used as a determiner to identify a specific singular masculine person, object, or entity nearby in space, present in time, or previously mentioned
definitions.text_mt: Determinant dimostrattiv maskil użat ma' nom definit biex jindika persuna, oġġett jew entità fil-qrib fl-ispazju, preżenti fil-ħin, jew li għadha kif issemmiet.

definitions.text_en: used as a pronoun to refer to a specific masculine person, thing, fact, or situation close at hand, currently experienced, or just stated
definitions.text_mt: Pronom dimostrattiv użat bħala suġġett jew oġġett biex jirreferi għal persuna, ħaġa, ġrajja jew sitwazzjoni konkreta jew astratta li tinsab fil-qrib jew li għadha kif ġiet ippreżentata.

definitions.text_en: indicating the current, ongoing, or immediately upcoming period of time
definitions.text_mt: Jindika l-perjodu ta' żmien kurrenti, kontinwu jew li ġej minnufih (eż. dan il-lejl, dan ix-xahar, dan is-sajf, daż-żmien).

usage_examples.mt: Dan il-ktieb fih tagħrif siewi ħafna dwar l-istorja ta' Malta.
usage_examples.en: This book contains very useful information about the history of Malta.

usage_examples.mt: Dan mhuwiex dak li ftehemna dwaru fil-laqgħa tal-bieraħ.
usage_examples.en: This is not what we agreed upon in yesterday's meeting.

usage_examples.mt: Se norganizzaw seminar nazzjonali dan ix-xahar.
usage_examples.en: We are organizing a national seminar this month.

etymology_chain.definition: this (feminine singular demonstrative base with analogical -n)

entries.etymology_notes: Inherited from Arabic feminine demonstrative base ذِي (ḏī). Modern comparative linguistics refutes an ancient Semitic substrate for final -n, analyzing it as an internal dialectal analogical extension from plural dawn / hadun to singular di > din, reinforced by the locative hawn ('here'). The bare stem survives in proclitic di, while Classical/MSA feminine هٰذِهِ (hāḏihī) / هٰذِي (hāḏī) survives in oratorical hedin via Maltese imāla.

definitions.text_en: this; used as a determiner to identify a specific singular feminine person, object, or entity nearby in space, present in time, or previously mentioned
definitions.text_mt: Determinant dimostrattiv femminil użat ma' nom definit biex jindika persuna, oġġett jew entità fil-qrib fl-ispazju, preżenti fil-ħin, jew li għadha kif issemmiet.

definitions.text_en: used as a pronoun to refer to a specific feminine person, thing, fact, or situation close at hand, currently experienced, or just stated
definitions.text_mt: Pronom dimostrattiv użat bħala suġġett jew oġġett biex jirreferi għal persuna, ħaġa, ġrajja jew sitwazzjoni konkreta jew astratta li tinsab fil-qrib jew li għadha kif ġiet ippreżentata.

definitions.text_en: indicating the current, ongoing, or immediately upcoming period or occasion (with feminine temporal nouns)
definitions.text_mt: Jindika l-perjodu ta' żmien jew l-okkażjoni kurrenti jew immedjata ma' nom femminili ta' żmien (eż. din il-ġimgħa, din is-sena, din id-darba).

usage_examples.mt: Din il-belt għandha storja rikka u arkitettura mill-isbaħ.
usage_examples.en: This city has a rich history and magnificent architecture.

usage_examples.mt: Din hija l-aqwa deċiżjoni li stajna nieħdu f'dawn iċ-ċirkostanzi.
usage_examples.en: This is the best decision we could have made in these circumstances.

usage_examples.mt: Se nlestu r-rapport finali tal-proġett matul din il-ġimgħa.
usage_examples.en: We will complete the project's final report during this week.

entries.etymology_notes: Inherited from dialectal Maghrebi Arabic plural demonstratives (cp. Tripoli hadun, Morocco hadun, Tunis hadhuna; Aquilina 1973: 16), rooted in Arabic ذَو (ḏaw) / هٰذُون (hādūn). Modern linguistic consensus identifies this plural nasal ending (-ūn / -un) as the analogical source that spread to singular dan and din. The bare proclitic survives in daw, while the Classical deictic prefix hā- survives in oratorical hedawn.

definitions.text_en: these; used as a determiner to identify specific plural people, objects, or entities nearby in space, present in time, or previously mentioned
definitions.text_mt: Determinant dimostrattiv plural użat ma' nom plural definit biex jindika persuni, oġġetti jew entitajiet fil-qrib fl-ispazju, preżenti fil-ħin, jew li għadhom kif issemmew.

definitions.text_en: used as a pronoun to refer to specific people, things, facts, or situations in the plural close at hand, currently experienced, or just stated
definitions.text_mt: Pronom dimostrattiv plural użat bħala suġġett jew oġġett biex jirreferi għal bosta persuni, affarijiet, ġrajjiet jew sitwazzjonijiet fil-qrib jew li għadhom kif ġew ippreżentati.

definitions.text_en: indicating the current era, recent times, or days currently unfolding
definitions.text_mt: Jindika ż-żmien preżenti, l-epoka kurrenti jew perjodu kontinwu fiż-żmien (eż. dawn il-jiem, dawn l-aħħar snin, dawż-żminijiet).

usage_examples.mt: Dawn l-istudenti ħadmu bla heda matul is-sena skolastika kollha.
usage_examples.en: These students worked tirelessly throughout the whole school year.

usage_examples.mt: Dawn huma r-riżultati ewlenin tal-istudju xjentifiku li wettaqna.
usage_examples.en: These are the main results of the scientific study we conducted.

usage_examples.mt: It-temp kien pjuttost xemxi u sabiħ matul dawn il-jiem.
usage_examples.en: The weather was rather sunny and pleasant over these past few days.

entries.etymology_notes: Direct continuation of the bare Arabic masculine demonstrative base ذَا (ḏā), preserving the original pre-analogical stem without suffixed -n or prefix hā- (Aquilina 1973: 16). Used as a proclitic attributive before the definite article or in temporal compounds (daż-żmien, dal-lejl).

definitions.text_en: this; proclitic and shortened attributive form of dan, prefixed or compounded before masculine nouns, adjectives, or the definite article
definitions.text_mt: Għamla mqassra u proklitika tad-determinant dimostrattiv maskil 'dan', użata quddiem l-artiklu jew f'komposti temporali (eż. daż-żmien, dal-lejl, dar-raġel).

definitions.text_en: used in temporal and adverbial expressions referring to the current time, night, or day (e.g. daż-żmien 'nowadays', dal-lejl 'tonight')
definitions.text_mt: Użat f'espressjonijiet temporali u avverbjali li jirreferu għaż-żmien kurrenti jew għal-lejl preżenti (eż. daż-żmien, dal-lejl).

usage_examples.mt: Daż-żmien in-nies qed iqattgħu aktar ħin fuq l-internet milli jaqraw kotba.
usage_examples.en: Nowadays people are spending more time on the internet than reading books.

usage_examples.mt: Dal-lejl se jagħmel il-kesħa f'ħafna partijiet tal-gżejjer.
usage_examples.en: Tonight it will be cold across many parts of the islands.

entries.audit_notes: Proclitic / shortened attributive variant of primary lemma 'dan'.

definitions.text_mt: Għamla mqassra u proklitika tad-determinant dimostrattiv femminil 'din', użata quddiem l-artiklu ma' nom femminili (eż. dil-mara, dil-ġimgħa).

definitions.text_en: used in temporal and situational expressions referring to the current feminine period or occasion (e.g. dil-ġimgħa 'this week', did-darba 'this time')
definitions.text_mt: Użat f'espressjonijiet temporali u sitwazzjonali ma' nom femminili (eż. dil-ġimgħa, did-darba).

usage_examples.mt: Dil-ġimgħa għandna diversi proġetti x'inlestu fuq ix-xogħol.
usage_examples.en: This week we have several projects to finish at work.

usage_examples.mt: Did-darba rridu noqogħdu attenti biex ma nirripetux l-istess żball.
usage_examples.en: This time we must be careful not to repeat the same mistake.

definitions.text_mt: Għamla mqassra u proklitika tad-determinant dimostrattiv plural 'dawn', użata quddiem l-artiklu ma' nom plural (eż. dawl-affarijiet, dawl-aħwa).

usage_examples.mt: F'dawż-żminijiet rari ssib min jieħu ħsieb l-ambjent kif suppost.

etymology_chain.definition: compound of deictic particle hā- + base ḏā

entries.etymology_notes: Directly derives from Classical/MSA هٰذَا (hāḏā), compounding the deictic alerting particle هَا (hā-) + demonstrative base ذَا (ḏā), with analogical -n and regular Maltese imāla (hā- > he-). Aquilina (1973: 16) notes this form survived 'confined to priests' sermons for oratorical effect' because sacred oratory preserved the elevated Classical/MSA compound with the deictic particle.

definitions.text_en: this; archaic and oratorical variant of dan, confined chiefly to priests' sermons, traditional preaching, and solemn ecclesiastical discourse for rhetorical effect
definitions.text_mt: Varjant oratorju u arkajku ta' 'dan', limitat l-aktar għall-priedki tal-qassisin u diskorsi solenni tal-knisja għal effett retoriku.

definitions.text_en: used as an emphatic demonstrative pronoun to introduce a theological truth, mystery, or solemn pronouncement
definitions.text_mt: Użat bħala pronom dimostrattiv enfatiku biex jippreżenta verità teoloġika, misteru jew stqarrija solenni.

usage_examples.mt: Hedan huwa l-misteru kbir tal-fidi li qegħdin niċċelebraw illum.
usage_examples.en: This is the great mystery of faith that we are celebrating today.

usage_examples.mt: Hedan il-jum imqaddes ifakkarna fl-imħabba infinita ta' Alla.
usage_examples.en: This holy day reminds us of God's infinite love.

entries.audit_notes: Confined to priests' sermons for oratorical effect; variant of primary lemma 'dan'.

definitions.text_en: this; shortened oratorical variant of hedan, confined to religious oratory, liturgical sermons, and pulpit eloquence for rhetorical effect
definitions.text_mt: Għamla mqassra ta' 'hedan', użata fil-priedki tal-qassisin u l-oratorija reliġjuża għal effett retoriku.

usage_examples.mt: Heda hu l-għemil li bih nuru s-spirtu Nisrani veru.
usage_examples.en: This is the deed whereby we display the true Christian spirit.

entries.audit_notes: Confined to priests' sermons for oratorical effect; apocopated variant of 'hedan'.

definitions.text_en: used as an emphatic feminine demonstrative pronoun to introduce a sacred virtue, grace, or teaching
definitions.text_mt: Użat bħala pronom dimostrattiv enfatiku femminil biex jippreżenta virtù, grazzja jew tagħlima sagra.

usage_examples.mt: Hedin hija l-grazzja li Alla ssawwab fuq il-poplu tiegħu.

usage_examples.mt: Hedin is-siegħa li fiha rridu niftħu qalbna għall-maħfra.

entries.etymology_notes: Derives from dialectal Arabic plural demonstrative with deictic prefix هَا (hā-), cognate with Maghrebi hadun / hadhuna and Classical/dialectal hādūn (هٰذُون). Preserved with imāla (hā- > he-) in Maltese pulpit oratory ('confined to priests' sermons for oratorical effect', Aquilina 1973: 16).

definitions.text_en: these; archaic and oratorical plural variant of dawn, confined chiefly to priests' sermons and pulpit eloquence for oratorical effect
definitions.text_mt: Varjant oratorju u arkajku plural ta' 'dawn', limitat prinċipalment għall-priedki tal-kleru u d-diskors reliġjuż għal effett retoriku.

definitions.text_en: used as an emphatic plural demonstrative pronoun to introduce solemn commandments, sacred words, or witnesses
definitions.text_mt: Użat bħala pronom dimostrattiv enfatiku plural biex jippreżenta kmandamenti, kliem qaddis jew xhieda solenni.

usage_examples.mt: Hedawn huma l-kliem qaddisa li ħallielna l-fundatur f'dan il-ktieb.
usage_examples.en: These are the holy words that the founder left us in this book.

usage_examples.mt: Hedawn in-nies tajba huma l-mudell ħaj tal-komunità tagħna.
usage_examples.en: These good people are the living model of our community.

entries.audit_notes: Confined to priests' sermons for oratorical effect; variant of companion lemma 'dawn'.

entries.etymology_notes: Apocopated plural variant reflecting the compound of deictic hā- (he-) + plural base daw without suffixed -n. Confined to priests' sermons and liturgical rhetoric for oratorical effect (Aquilina 1973: 16).

definitions.text_en: these; shortened oratorical variant of hedawn, confined to ecclesiastical oratory and priests' sermons for rhetorical effect
definitions.text_mt: Għamla mqassra ta' 'hedawn', użata fil-priedki reliġjużi għal effett retoriku.

usage_examples.mt: Hedaw huma t-tagħlimiet li rridu ngħaddu lil uliedna f'kull żmien.
usage_examples.en: These are the teachings that we must pass on to our children in every age.

entries.audit_notes: Confined to priests' sermons for oratorical effect; apocopated variant of 'hedawn'.

entries.etymology_notes: Aquilina (1973: 16): Oratorical masculine demonstrative with prefixed particle he- (hā-). Aquilina notes: 'all forms still in current use, those with initial he, being confined to priests' sermons for oratorical effect'.

definitions.text_en: which, what (interrogative)
definitions.text_mt: Pronomu interrogattiv użat fil-mistoqsijiet dwar għażla.

usage_examples.mt: Liema ktieb trid taqra mit-tnejn li hemm fuq il-mejda?
usage_examples.en: Which book do you want to read of the two on the table?
